items.title: Dysfunction of the blood-brain barrier and neurovascular unit in amyotrophic lateral sclerosis - From advanced human models to treatments.
items.summary: Amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS) is a fatal neurodegenerative disorder, characterized by the degeneration of motor neurons, resulting in progressive and eventually complete loss of motor function. The phenotypical heterogeneity of ALS poses a challenge to early diagnosis and treatment, with currently available therapeutics only capable of relieving symptoms and slowing progression. While ALS is classified as a motor neuron disease (MND), research has identified significant impairment to the blood-brain barrier (BBB) and neurovascular unit (NVU) of ALS patients. The BBB along with supporting cells of the NVU selectively control the entry of substances into the central nervous system (CNS) and maintain brain homeostasis, with its many cellular components demonstrating impaired function, specifically relating to inflammation, oxidative stress and TDP-43 proteinopathy. The advent of more advanced in vitro techniques as well as use of patient-derived BBB cells has presented a promising alternative to recreate the in vivo structure of the BBB/NVU in a highly controlled platform. Such approaches have ranged from simple 2-dimensional (2D) cell culture to intricate 3-dimensional (3D) co-culture systems, as well as microfluidic systems and organoids, with a potential to investigate ALS associated BBB/NVU dysfunction and drug discovery. This review provides a comprehensive assessment of known BBB/NVU dysfunction in ALS and methods of investigating this using in vitro and in vivo platforms with a focus on inflammation, oxidative stress and pathological TDP-43 expression. This review also presents a future perspective to overcoming barriers to treatment of ALS using new patient-derived BBB/NVU model systems.
items.titleZh: 肌萎缩侧索硬化中血脑屏障与神经血管单元的功能障碍——从先进人类模型到治疗
items.summaryZh: 这是一篇综述，系统梳理了ALS中血脑屏障和神经血管单元的功能障碍，重点涉及炎症、氧化应激和TDP-43蛋白病变。文章还总结了从2D培养到3D共培养、微流控和类器官等体外模型，以及患者来源BBB细胞在模拟ALS病理和药物筛选中的应用前景。
items.insight: 该综述将ALS的病理视野从运动神经元扩展到血脑屏障和神经血管单元，并系统盘点了患者来源细胞、3D共培养、微流控和类器官等人类相关模型。对ALS研究者而言，其价值在于提示BBB/NVU功能障碍可能是被低估的治疗靶点，同时为构建更贴近人类病理的体外筛选平台提供了方法学参考。

items.abstractZh: 肌萎缩侧索硬化（ALS）是一种致命的神经退行性疾病，以运动神经元变性为特征，导致运动功能进行性并最终完全丧失。ALS的表型异质性给早期诊断和治疗带来挑战，目前可用的治疗手段仅能缓解症状并延缓进展。尽管ALS被归类为运动神经元病（MND），研究已发现ALS患者的血脑屏障（BBB）和神经血管单元（NVU）存在显著损伤。BBB与NVU的支持细胞选择性控制物质进入中枢神经系统（CNS）并维持脑稳态，其多种细胞成分表现出功能受损，尤其与炎症、氧化应激和TDP-43蛋白病变相关。更先进的体外技术以及患者来源BBB细胞的应用，为在高度可控平台上重建BBB/NVU的体内结构提供了有前景的替代方案。此类方法从简单的二维（2D）细胞培养到复杂的三维（3D）共培养系统，以及微流控系统和类器官，具有研究ALS相关BBB/NVU功能障碍和药物发现的潜力。本综述全面评估了ALS中已知的BBB/NVU功能障碍，以及利用体外和体内平台研究这一问题的方法，重点关注炎症、氧化应激和病理性TDP-43表达。本综述还提出了利用新的患者来源BBB/NVU模型系统克服ALS治疗障碍的未来展望。
items.frontierRationale: 该综述聚焦ALS中血脑屏障与神经血管单元功能障碍这一新近受关注的方向，并强调患者来源先进人类模型在机制研究和药物发现中的转化价值。

items.title: The thymus gland is a target and maintainer of amyotrophic lateral sclerosis pathophysiology.
items.summary: Amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS) is a fatal neurodegenerative disease characterized by the selective loss of motor neurons in the brain and spinal cord with evidence of local neuroinflammation. Regulatory T cells (Treg) exert neuroprotective effects and correlate with disease progression, but central mechanisms governing Treg development during ALS remain unclear. We investigated the thymic architecture and T cell differentiation in SOD1-G93A (mSOD1) ALS mice at multiple disease stages. Thymocyte and thymic epithelial cells (TEC) subpopulations, as well as stages of Treg differentiation and suppressive capacity, were analyzed by flow cytometry, in situ immunofluorescence, and functional assays. At late disease stage (120 days-old), mSOD1 mice displayed thymic atrophy, reduced thymocyte numbers, and decreased double-positive (DP), CD4 single-positive (SP), and Treg populations. Foxp3 expression per cell was preserved, but Treg progenitors and mature Treg numbers declined, paralleled by reduced suppressive function in vitro . TEC analysis revealed reduced total and mature medullary TEC (CD80 high MHCII high ), despite preserved Aire expression. Foxp3 + cells were abnormally localized at cortical sites, away from mTEC, associated with migratory abnormalities and increased apoptosis. TREC evaluation revealed reduced intrathymic sjTREC, consistent with impaired proliferation and differentiation between DN and DP stages, although peripheral sj/βTREC ratios remained stable. Reduced Treg numbers were also observed in lymph nodes draining affected hindlimbs. Our findings identify the thymus as a target organ in ALS, where thymic involution, TEC loss, and Treg dysfunction may compromise immune tolerance. These alterations likely reinforce the role of the thymus in peripheral immune dysregulation and neuroinflammation observed in ALS.
items.titleZh: 胸腺是肌萎缩侧索硬化病理生理学的靶标和维持者
items.summaryZh: 该研究在SOD1-G93A ALS小鼠模型中发现，疾病晚期胸腺出现萎缩、胸腺上皮细胞丢失和Treg发育及功能受损，提示胸腺可能是ALS免疫失调的重要源头。
items.insight: 这项研究将ALS的免疫机制从外周前移到中枢免疫器官胸腺，提出胸腺退化可能是Treg功能缺陷的上游原因。对于关注神经炎症和免疫调节治疗的ALS研究者，这提示靶向胸腺或Treg发育通路可能成为新的干预方向，并值得在患者组织中验证。

aiRead.keyFinding: SOD1-G93A ALS小鼠在疾病晚期出现胸腺萎缩、髓质胸腺上皮细胞丢失、Treg发育和抑制功能受损，提示胸腺是ALS免疫失调的靶器官。
aiRead.limitation: 研究仅基于SOD1-G93A小鼠模型，尚未在ALS患者中验证；胸腺改变与疾病进展的因果关系及具体分子机制仍需进一步研究。
aiRead.watchNext: 后续可关注在ALS患者胸腺或外周血中验证Treg发育异常，以及靶向胸腺或Treg通路能否改善疾病进程的临床前和临床研究。

items.abstractZh: 肌萎缩侧索硬化（ALS）是一种致死性神经退行性疾病，其特征是脑和脊髓中运动神经元的选择性丢失，并伴有局部神经炎症的证据。调节性T细胞（Treg）发挥神经保护作用并与疾病进展相关，但ALS期间调控Treg发育的中枢机制仍不清楚。我们在多个疾病阶段研究了SOD1-G93A（mSOD1）ALS小鼠的胸腺结构和T细胞分化。通过流式细胞术、原位免疫荧光和功能实验分析了胸腺细胞和胸腺上皮细胞（TEC）亚群，以及Treg分化的各个阶段和抑制能力。在疾病晚期（120日龄），mSOD1小鼠表现出胸腺萎缩、胸腺细胞数量减少，以及双阳性（DP）、CD4单阳性（SP）和Treg群体减少。每个细胞的Foxp3表达得以保留，但Treg祖细胞和成熟Treg数量下降，同时体外抑制功能降低。TEC分析显示总TEC和成熟髓质TEC（CD80高MHCII高）减少，尽管Aire表达得以保留。Foxp3+细胞异常定位于皮质区域，远离mTEC，与迁移异常和凋亡增加相关。TREC评估显示胸腺内sjTREC减少，与DN和DP阶段之间的增殖和分化受损一致，尽管外周sj/βTREC比值保持稳定。在引流受累后肢的淋巴结中也观察到Treg数量减少。我们的发现确定胸腺是ALS的靶器官，其中胸腺退化、TEC丢失和Treg功能障碍可能损害免疫耐受。这些改变可能强化了胸腺在ALS中观察到的外周免疫失调和神经炎症中的作用。
items.frontierRationale: 该研究新近揭示了胸腺作为ALS免疫失调上游靶器官的作用，为理解Treg功能障碍和神经炎症提供了转化价值。

items.title: Repairing the Amyotrophic Lateral Sclerosis Trial Credibility Gap.
items.summary: There is a long history of early- and mid-phase amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS) clinical trial data being used to make claims of clinical benefit that fail to translate into successful phase 3 outcomes. It is suggested that fallacious scientific reasoning is being encouraged by perverse incentives arising from a "clinical trial industrial complex" that greatly influences trial design, data interpretation, and results communication. Recurring fallacies include false premises underlying outcome comparisons, misuse and incorrect interpretation of biomarkers, mismatches between study design and stated objectives, selective reporting of outcomes, over-reliance on post hoc analyses and open-label extension data, and overly optimistic framing of inconclusive data. We argue that these practices, reinforced by misaligned incentives across industry and academia, lead to premature claims of therapeutic promise and tangible harm to patients. To address the resulting ALS clinical trial credibility gap, we call for rigorous adherence to established standards for reporting clinical trial results, clearer distinction between hypothesis generation and hypothesis testing, more measured description of trial results, and more disciplined triage of phase 2 programs. A cultural shift toward scientific skepticism and methodological rigor is essential to accelerate the development of genuinely effective ALS therapies.
items.titleZh: 弥合肌萎缩侧索硬化症临床试验的可信度差距
items.summaryZh: 这篇评论文章指出，ALS早期临床试验常被用来宣称疗效，但很少能在3期试验中兑现，造成“可信度差距”。作者认为，产业界与学术界激励错位催生的“临床试验工业复合体”助长了多种方法学谬误，包括错误前提、生物标志物误用、设计目标不匹配、选择性报告、过度依赖事后分析和开放标签数据，以及对不确定结果的乐观包装。文章呼吁严格报告标准、区分假设生成与检验、审慎解读结果，并更严格地筛选2期项目。
items.insight: 对ALS研究者而言，这篇文章的价值不在于报告新疗法，而在于系统梳理了导致ALS试验反复失败的方法学与传播问题。它提醒研究者在设计、解读和传播早期试验结果时避免过度外推，并强调生物标志物、事后分析和开放标签数据不能替代确证性证据。这对优化2期到3期的转化路径、减少患者暴露于无效治疗具有直接参考意义。

aiRead.keyFinding: ALS早期和中期试验数据常被过度解读为临床获益，但未能转化为3期成功；根源在于“临床试验工业复合体”激励扭曲下的多种科学推理谬误。
aiRead.limitation: 本文为观点性评论，未提供新的原始数据或系统综述，所提出的改革建议缺乏实证验证。
aiRead.watchNext: 关注ALS临床试验报告标准、2期项目分流标准以及生物标志物使用规范是否因此发生实际调整。

items.abstractZh: 长期以来，肌萎缩侧索硬化症（ALS）早期和中期临床试验数据被用来声称具有临床获益，但这些声称未能转化为成功的3期试验结果。文章指出，一个极大影响试验设计、数据解读和结果传播的“临床试验工业复合体”所产生的扭曲激励，正在助长错误的科学推理。反复出现的谬误包括：结局比较所依据的错误前提、生物标志物的误用和错误解读、研究设计与所述目标之间的不匹配、结局的选择性报告、过度依赖事后分析和开放标签扩展数据，以及对无定论数据的过度乐观表述。我们认为，这些做法在产业界和学术界激励错位的强化下，导致对治疗前景的过早宣称，并对患者造成实际伤害。为弥合由此产生的ALS临床试验可信度差距，我们呼吁严格遵循既定的临床试验结果报告标准，更清晰地区分假设生成与假设检验，更审慎地描述试验结果，并对2期项目进行更有纪律的分流。向科学怀疑精神和方法学严谨性的文化转变，对于加速开发真正有效的ALS疗法至关重要。
items.frontierRationale: 该文于2026年发表，直面ALS临床试验长期存在的转化可信度问题，对试验设计、生物标志物解读和结果报告提出方法学改革呼吁，具有推动ALS疗法开发路径优化的转化价值。

items.title: LRP12 CGG Repeat Expansions in Patients With Adult-Onset Non-5q Spinal Muscular Atrophy.
items.summary: Non-5q spinal muscular atrophy (SMA) is genetically heterogeneous, yet many adult-onset cases remain molecularly undiagnosed. CGG repeat expansions in the 5' untranslated region of LRP12 , originally identified in oculopharyngodistal myopathy, have also been implicated in amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS) and inherited peripheral neuropathy. The aim of this study was to determine whether LRP12 CGG repeat expansions occur in patients with adult-onset proximal-predominant non-5q SMA and characterize the associated clinical presentations. In this observational case series, we enrolled 8 consecutive, genetically unresolved families that met prespecified criteria for adult-onset non-5q SMA after exclusion of known genetic causes of SMA and familial ALS by comprehensive genetic evaluation, including whole-exome sequencing. LRP12 CGG repeat expansions were screened by repeat-primed PCR and then confirmed and sized by Oxford Nanopore long-read sequencing. LRP12 CGG repeat expansions were also screened in 496 unrelated ALS cases and 1,000 controls. Monoallelic LRP12 CGG repeat expansions were identified in 6 of the 8 non-5q SMA probands (75%). Five of the 6 positive families were consistent with autosomal-dominant inheritance. Expanded alleles ranged from 58 to 92 repeat units. Affected individuals showed adult-onset, slowly progressive, proximal-predominant pure lower motor neuron weakness with preserved bulbar and sensory function and no upper motor neuron signs. Expansions were rare in ALS cases (2/496, 0.40%) and controls (2/1,000, 0.20%). We identified LRP12 CGG repeat expansions in a substantial proportion of patients with slowly progressive, proximal-predominant pure lower motor neuron weakness not linked to 5q-SMA. These findings broaden the clinical spectrum of LRP12 -related disease and support inclusion of LRP12 repeat-expansion analysis in the evaluation of genetically unresolved adult-onset lower motor neuron syndromes.
items.titleZh: 成人起病非5q型脊髓性肌萎缩症患者中的LRP12 CGG重复扩增
items.summaryZh: 这项观察性病例系列研究在8个遗传学未明确的成人起病非5q型SMA家系中，发现6个家系（75%）携带LRP12基因CGG重复扩增，扩增范围为58至92个重复单位，多数符合常染色体显性遗传。患者表现为成人起病、缓慢进展、以近端为主的纯下运动神经元无力，延髓和感觉功能保留，无上运动神经元体征。该扩增在496例ALS中仅2例（0.40%）、1000例对照中仅2例（0.20%）。研究提示LRP12重复扩增可解释部分成人起病下运动神经元综合征，并建议将其纳入遗传学未明确病例的检测。
items.insight: 该研究将LRP12 CGG重复扩增从眼咽远端型肌病和ALS相关基因拓展到成人起病非5q型SMA，提示LRP12重复扩增是成人起病下运动神经元综合征的一个可检测遗传病因。对ALS研究者而言，其价值在于：LRP12扩增在ALS中虽罕见（0.40%），但可出现在纯下运动神经元表型中，与ALS鉴别诊断相关；同时提示在遗传学未明确的运动神经元病中应纳入重复扩增检测，而非仅依赖外显子测序。

items.abstractZh: 非5q型脊髓性肌萎缩症（SMA）具有遗传异质性，但许多成人起病病例在分子层面仍无法确诊。LRP12基因5'非翻译区的CGG重复扩增最初在眼咽远端型肌病中被发现，此后也被认为与肌萎缩侧索硬化（ALS）及遗传性周围神经病相关。本研究旨在确定成人起病、以近端为主的非5q型SMA患者中是否存在LRP12 CGG重复扩增，并描述其相关临床表现。在这项观察性病例系列研究中，我们连续入组了8个遗传学上未明确的家系，这些家系在通过全面遗传学评估（包括全外显子组测序）排除已知SMA和家族性ALS遗传病因后，符合成人起病非5q型SMA的预设标准。LRP12 CGG重复扩增通过重复引物PCR进行筛查，随后通过Oxford Nanopore长读长测序进行确认和片段大小测定。同时还在496例无关ALS病例和1000例对照中筛查了LRP12 CGG重复扩增。在8例非5q型SMA先证者中，有6例（75%）检出单等位基因LRP12 CGG重复扩增。6个阳性家系中有5个符合常染色体显性遗传。扩增等位基因范围为58至92个重复单位。受累个体表现为成人起病、缓慢进展、以近端为主的纯下运动神经元无力，延髓功能和感觉功能保留，且无上运动神经元体征。该扩增在ALS病例中罕见（2/496，0.40%），在对照中亦罕见（2/1000，0.20%）。我们在相当一部分缓慢进展、以近端为主的纯下运动神经元无力且与5q型SMA无关的患者中发现了LRP12 CGG重复扩增。这些发现拓宽了LRP12相关疾病的临床谱，并支持在遗传学未明确的成人起病下运动神经元综合征评估中纳入LRP12重复扩增分析。
items.frontierRationale: 该研究新近将LRP12 CGG重复扩增与成人起病非5q型SMA联系起来，拓展了ALS相关重复扩增疾病的临床谱，并支持在遗传学未明确的成人下运动神经元综合征中进行LRP12重复扩增检测，具有转化诊断价值。

items.title: Herbal nanoparticles in the treatment of neurodegeneration: from molecular mechanisms to therapeutic translation.
items.summary: Neurodegenerative diseases (NDDs), including Alzheimer's disease, Parkinson's disease, Huntington's disease, and amyotrophic lateral sclerosis, are characterized by progressive neuronal loss involving multiple pathological mechanisms, including protein aggregation, oxidative stress, neuroinflammation, and mitochondrial dysfunction. Although conventional therapies provide symptomatic relief, they fail to halt disease progression and are limited by poor blood-brain barrier (BBB) penetration, off-target effects, and systemic toxicity. Likewise, several herbal bioactives, such as curcumin, resveratrol, quercetin, and epigallocatechin gallate, exhibit promising neuroprotective properties but suffer from poor aqueous solubility, low oral bioavailability, rapid metabolism, and inadequate brain delivery. Nanotechnology-based delivery systems have emerged as a promising approach to overcome these pharmacokinetic limitations by enhancing stability, controlled release, BBB transport, and brain accumulation of herbal therapeutics. This review critically summarizes recent advances in herbal nanoformulations, emphasizing disease-specific molecular targets, BBB-targeting strategies, comparative nanocarrier systems, pharmacokinetic optimization, intracellular trafficking, and translational challenges. Unlike previous reviews, it integrates recent evidence on nanotoxicology, manufacturing scalability, quality control, regulatory considerations, and emerging technologies, including biomimetic nanoparticles and extracellular vesicles. Despite encouraging preclinical outcomes, clinical evidence remains limited, and no herbal nanoformulation has yet demonstrated definitive efficacy or received regulatory approval for neurodegenerative diseases. Future clinical translation will require standardized formulations, rigorous safety evaluation, and well-designed clinical trials. Unlike previous reviews that primarily summarize individual nanocarrier systems or herbal therapeutics, the present review provides a comprehensive and critical synthesis of the current evidence by integrating disease-specific molecular mechanisms, herbal bioactives, nanocarrier design strategies, blood-brain barrier transport mechanisms, intracellular trafficking, pharmacokinetic considerations, translational barriers, regulatory challenges, clinical evidence, and emerging technologies. Furthermore, the review identifies major knowledge gaps and future research priorities to facilitate the successful clinical translation of herbal nanoformulations for neurodegenerative disorders. The online version contains supplementary material available at https://doi.org/10.1007/s13205-026-05048-8.

items.titleZh: 草药纳米颗粒在神经退行性疾病治疗中的应用：从分子机制到治疗转化
items.summaryZh: 这是一篇综述，系统梳理了草药来源的生物活性分子（如姜黄素、白藜芦醇、槲皮素、EGCG）通过纳米递送系统治疗神经退行性疾病（含ALS）的研究进展。文章重点讨论了如何利用纳米载体改善这些分子水溶性差、口服吸收低、难以穿过血脑屏障等问题，并覆盖了疾病相关分子靶点、纳米载体设计、血脑屏障转运、细胞内转运、药代动力学、纳米毒理、生产放大、质量控制和监管等转化环节。作者明确指出：目前证据主要来自临床前研究，尚无草药纳米制剂在神经退行性疾病中证明明确疗效或获批，临床证据有限。
items.insight: 对ALS研究者而言，这篇综述的价值在于把“草药活性分子+纳米递送”这一相对分散的领域，放到了神经退行性疾病共同病理机制（蛋白聚集、氧化应激、神经炎症、线粒体功能障碍）和血脑屏障递送瓶颈下进行系统评估。它提醒我们：ALS的候选草药纳米疗法不能只停留在体外神经保护或动物模型改善，还必须回答制剂标准化、脑内暴露、长期安全性、生产可放大性和监管路径等问题。若后续有团队将这类纳米制剂推进到ALS临床试验，本文所列的药代动力学优化、细胞内转运和转化障碍清单可作为设计对照和终点选择时的参考框架。

aiRead.keyFinding: 草药生物活性分子具有神经保护潜力，但受限于溶解性、生物利用度和脑内递送；纳米递送系统在临床前研究中显示可改善这些限制，然而目前尚无草药纳米制剂在神经退行性疾病中证明明确疗效或获得监管批准。
aiRead.limitation: 本文为综述，不提供新的原始临床或实验数据；所引证据以临床前研究为主，临床证据有限，且未针对ALS进行专门临床试验验证。
aiRead.watchNext: 关注是否有草药纳米制剂进入ALS或其他神经退行性疾病的规范临床试验，尤其是制剂标准化、血脑屏障靶向效率、长期纳米毒性和监管路径方面的后续进展。

items.abstractZh: 神经退行性疾病（NDDs），包括阿尔茨海默病、帕金森病、亨廷顿病和肌萎缩侧索硬化，其特征为进行性神经元丢失，涉及多种病理机制，包括蛋白质聚集、氧化应激、神经炎症和线粒体功能障碍。尽管传统疗法可提供症状缓解，但无法阻止疾病进展，并受限于血脑屏障（BBB）穿透性差、脱靶效应和全身毒性。同样，几种草药生物活性成分，如姜黄素、白藜芦醇、槲皮素和表没食子儿茶素没食子酸酯，表现出有前景的神经保护特性，但存在水溶性差、口服生物利用度低、代谢迅速和脑内递送不足的问题。基于纳米技术的递送系统已成为克服这些药代动力学限制的有前景方法，通过增强草药治疗剂的稳定性、控释、BBB转运和脑内蓄积。本综述批判性地总结了草药纳米制剂的最新进展，强调疾病特异性分子靶点、BBB靶向策略、比较纳米载体系统、药代动力学优化、细胞内转运和转化挑战。与以往综述不同，它整合了关于纳米毒理学、制造可扩展性、质量控制、监管考虑以及新兴技术（包括仿生纳米颗粒和细胞外囊泡）的最新证据。尽管临床前结果令人鼓舞，但临床证据仍然有限，尚无草药纳米制剂在神经退行性疾病中显示出明确疗效或获得监管批准。未来的临床转化需要标准化制剂、严格的安全性评估和精心设计的临床试验。与主要总结单个纳米载体系统或草药治疗剂的以往综述不同，本综述通过整合疾病特异性分子机制、草药生物活性成分、纳米载体设计策略、血脑屏障转运机制、细胞内转运、药代动力学考虑、转化障碍、监管挑战、临床证据和新兴技术，提供了当前证据的全面而批判性的综合。此外，本综述确定了主要知识空白和未来研究重点，以促进草药纳米制剂用于神经退行性疾病的成功临床转化。在线版本包含补充材料，可在 https://doi.org/10.1007/s13205-026-05048-8 获取。
items.frontierRationale: 该综述新近整合了仿生纳米颗粒和细胞外囊泡等新兴递送技术，并直接覆盖ALS等神经退行性疾病的血脑屏障递送与转化瓶颈，对评估草药纳米疗法的临床转化前景具有参考价值。

items.title: Artificial Intelligence in Neuromuscular Diseases: Opportunities for a Data-Scarce Field.
items.summary: Neuromuscular diseases (NMDs) encompass over 800 distinct entities affecting approximately one in 1000 individuals worldwide, with progressive muscle weakness, atrophy, and motor impairment as primary clinical manifestations. The rarity of most NMDs creates fundamental challenges for artificial intelligence (AI) and machine learning (ML) applications that typically require large-scale datasets. In this narrative review we synthesize the literature published between 2018 and 2025 on AI applications across the NMD spectrum, organized by clinical application domain. We examine how AI has advanced diagnostic capabilities through genetic variant interpretation, muscle magnetic resonance imaging analysis, electromyography-based classification, and computational pathology. In disease monitoring and prognosis, wearable-derived digital biomarkers have achieved regulatory qualification (US Food and Drug Administration [FDA] and European Medicines Agency [EMA]) as clinical trial endpoints for Duchenne muscular dystrophy, while AI-driven survival models for amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS) have been validated across 14 European centers. Proteomic and multi-omics analyses using ML have identified diagnostic panels for ALS. However, most reported models were developed and internally validated on single-center datasets, and few have undergone external or prospective validation or clinical implementation. Despite these achievements, research intensity varies dramatically across NMD subtypes, with ALS and Duchenne muscular dystrophy dominating while myotonic dystrophy, congenital myopathies, and metabolic myopathies remain virtually unexplored. Critical gaps persist in computational pathology, multi-center validation, and clinical translation. In this review, we discuss how federated learning, international collaborative networks (TREAT-NMD, Solve-RD, EURO-NMD), and foundation models can address these challenges, and propose directions for future AI-enhanced clinical studies in this data-scarce field.
items.titleZh: 人工智能在神经肌肉疾病中的应用：数据稀缺领域的机遇
items.summaryZh: 这是一篇2026年发表的叙述性综述，系统梳理了2018至2025年间人工智能在神经肌肉疾病中的应用。文章指出，ALS和杜氏肌营养不良症是AI研究最集中的两个病种：AI驱动的ALS生存模型已在14个欧洲中心获得验证，基于ML的蛋白质组学分析也识别出了ALS诊断组合；可穿戴数字生物标志物已获FDA和EMA资格认定作为杜氏肌营养不良症试验终点。但整体而言，多数模型仅在单中心数据上开发和内部验证，缺乏外部验证和临床落地；强直性肌营养不良、先天性肌病和代谢性肌病等亚型几乎无人涉足。作者提出联邦学习、国际协作网络和基础模型是突破数据稀缺瓶颈的可行路径。
items.insight: 对ALS研究者而言，这篇综述的价值在于它明确指出了当前AI在ALS中已走到哪一步、卡在哪里。ALS生存模型的多中心验证和蛋白质组学诊断组合是已有实质进展的方向，但单中心开发、缺乏外部验证是普遍短板。文章提出的联邦学习和基础模型思路，直接回应了ALS作为罕见病难以汇聚大规模数据的核心矛盾，为后续研究设计提供了可参考的框架。同时，它提示ALS在NMD的AI研究中已属"资源集中"病种，研究者应关注如何将这种相对优势转化为可外部验证、可临床实施的工具。

items.abstractZh: 神经肌肉疾病（NMDs）涵盖800多种不同实体，影响全球约千分之一的人群，主要临床表现为进行性肌无力、萎缩和运动障碍。大多数NMD的罕见性给通常需要大规模数据集的人工智能（AI）和机器学习（ML）应用带来了根本性挑战。在这篇叙述性综述中，我们按临床应用领域组织，综合了2018年至2025年间发表的关于AI在NMD谱系中应用的文献。我们审视了AI如何通过遗传变异解读、肌肉磁共振成像分析、基于肌电图的分类和计算病理学推进诊断能力。在疾病监测和预后方面，可穿戴设备衍生的数字生物标志物已获得监管资格（美国食品药品监督管理局[FDA]和欧洲药品管理局[EMA]）作为杜氏肌营养不良症的临床试验终点，而AI驱动的肌萎缩侧索硬化症（ALS）生存模型已在14个欧洲中心得到验证。使用ML的蛋白质组学和多组学分析已识别出ALS的诊断组合。然而，大多数报道的模型是在单中心数据集上开发和内部验证的，很少有模型经过外部或前瞻性验证或临床实施。尽管取得了这些成就，不同NMD亚型的研究强度差异巨大，ALS和杜氏肌营养不良症占主导地位，而强直性肌营养不良、先天性肌病和代谢性肌病几乎未被探索。在计算病理学、多中心验证和临床转化方面仍存在关键差距。在这篇综述中，我们讨论了联邦学习、国际合作网络（TREAT-NMD、Solve-RD、EURO-NMD）和基础模型如何应对这些挑战，并提出了这一数据稀缺领域未来AI增强临床研究的方向。
items.frontierRationale: 该综述整合了2018至2025年AI在神经肌肉疾病中的最新进展，明确指出ALS生存模型已获14个欧洲中心验证、ALS蛋白质组学诊断组合已被ML识别，同时点出联邦学习与基础模型是突破ALS等罕见病数据稀缺瓶颈的前沿方向，对ALS转化研究具有直接参考价值。

items.title: Selective targeting of the oligodendroglial GPR17 receptor improves myelin integrity and motor function in female SOD1 G93A mice.
items.summary: Amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS) is a fatal neurodegenerative disease with no definitive disease-modifying therapies available, underscoring the urgent need to identify novel druggable targets. The G protein-coupled receptor GPR17 is a critical regulator of oligodendrocyte maturation and has emerged as a candidate target in ALS, yet its relevance to human disease and its therapeutic potential remain unclear. Here, we demonstrate that pathological GPR17 upregulation defines a conserved, pathologically immature oligodendroglial state in human ALS that can be pharmacologically leveraged to restore myelin integrity and improve functional outcome in vivo. Publicly available transcriptomics datasets and histological analyses revealed an increased abundance of GPR17-expressing immature oligodendrocytes in post-mortem human spinal cord tissue from ALS cases. Moreover, sustained activation of GPR17 with a selective agonist induced GPR17 internalization in heterologous expression systems and promoted the differentiation of primary oligodendrocyte precursors derived from SOD1 G93A mice. Translating these findings in vivo, chronic treatment with a brain-penetrant GPR17 agonist derived from the same pharmacological class significantly extended survival, delayed body weight loss, and improved motor performance in female SOD1 G93A mice, whereas male mice showed no therapeutic benefit. These effects were associated with restored oligodendrocyte maturation, preserved myelin integrity, motor neuron survival, and attenuated reactive gliosis in the spinal cord of female SOD1 G93A mice, while milder effects were observed in males. Together, these findings establish oligodendroglial GPR17 as a conserved and pharmacologically actionable target in ALS and show that sustained in vivo GPR17 agonism can reprogram altered oligodendroglial states and slow disease progression in a sex-dependent manner.
items.titleZh: 选择性靶向少突胶质细胞GPR17受体可改善雌性SOD1 G93A小鼠的髓鞘完整性和运动功能
items.summaryZh: 该研究在人类ALS脊髓组织中发现表达GPR17的未成熟少突胶质细胞增多，提示GPR17上调与病理性的少突胶质细胞成熟障碍相关。在SOD1 G93A小鼠模型中，使用脑渗透性GPR17激动剂长期治疗可延长雌性小鼠生存期、改善运动功能并保护髓鞘和运动神经元，但雄性小鼠无显著获益。研究提示靶向GPR17可能通过促进少突胶质细胞成熟来减缓ALS进展，且疗效存在性别差异。
items.insight: 这项研究将人类ALS组织学发现与SOD1 G93A小鼠的体内药理学干预相连接，为少突胶质细胞功能障碍在ALS中的作用提供了转化证据。GPR17作为可成药GPCR，其激动剂在雌性小鼠中显示多维度获益（生存、运动、髓鞘、运动神经元），值得关注其性别差异机制及向人类试验推进的可能性。

items.abstractZh: 肌萎缩侧索硬化（ALS）是一种致命的神经退行性疾病，目前尚无明确的疾病修饰疗法，这凸显了识别新型可成药靶点的迫切需求。G蛋白偶联受体GPR17是少突胶质细胞成熟的关键调节因子，并已成为ALS的候选靶点，但其与人类疾病的相关性及治疗潜力仍不明确。在此，我们证明病理性GPR17上调定义了人类ALS中一种保守的、病理性未成熟的少突胶质细胞状态，可通过药理学手段加以利用，以在体内恢复髓鞘完整性并改善功能结局。公开可用的转录组数据集和组织学分析显示，ALS病例死后人脊髓组织中表达GPR17的未成熟少突胶质细胞丰度增加。此外，使用选择性激动剂持续激活GPR17可在异源表达系统中诱导GPR17内化，并促进源自SOD1 G93A小鼠的原代少突胶质前体细胞分化。将这些发现转化为体内实验，使用源自同一药理学类别的脑渗透性GPR17激动剂进行长期治疗，可显著延长雌性SOD1 G93A小鼠的生存期、延缓体重下降并改善运动表现，而雄性小鼠未显示治疗获益。这些效应与雌性SOD1 G93A小鼠脊髓中少突胶质细胞成熟恢复、髓鞘完整性保留、运动神经元存活及反应性胶质增生减弱相关，而在雄性中观察到较轻微的效果。总之，这些发现确立了少突胶质细胞GPR17作为ALS中一个保守且药理学上可操作的靶点，并表明持续的体内GPR17激动可重编程改变的少突胶质细胞状态，并以性别依赖的方式减缓疾病进展。
items.frontierRationale: 该研究新近揭示了GPR17作为ALS中保守且可药理干预的少突胶质细胞靶点，并在SOD1 G93A小鼠中证明其激动剂可改善髓鞘完整性和运动功能，具有明确的转化价值。

items.title: Polyamines across neurodegenerative proteinopathies.
items.summary: Polyamines (PAs) are evolutionarily conserved metabolites that connect protein quality control with lysosomal, mitochondrial, and redox homeostasis. Their metabolism is situated at a critical intersection of cell-sustaining and neurodegenerative pathways. Here, we synthesize evidence across Alzheimer's disease, Parkinson's disease, polyglutamine repeat disorders, amyotrophic lateral sclerosis, and multiple system atrophy, each of which differ in vulnerability to changes in PA metabolism. Although previous reviews have investigated polyamines in individual neurodegenerative disorders, few have compared their roles across the broader spectrum of neurodegenerative proteinopathies. Here, we address this gap by synthesizing evidence across multiple diseases to examine how PAs influence disease-associated protein aggregation and clearance, and how these effects depend on PA species, concentration, cellular context, disease stage, subcellular localization, redox state, and lysosomal and mitochondrial capacity. Human tissue and biofluid studies report disease-associated changes in PA metabolites, pathway enzymes, and transporter remodeling, as a function of neurodegenerative disorders. Mechanistic studies reveal that spermidine and spermine can alter the assembly, condensation, compartmentalization, and clearance of various neurotoxic proteins, whereas the effects of putrescine are more system- and concentration-dependent. These effects engage both shared pathways and distinct mechanisms, depending on protein identity, cell type, and subcellular location. Curiously, PA manipulation may be protective in one context yet harmful in another. The framework that we propose can distinguish adaptive remodeling from pathogenic dysregulation and can guide disease-relevant therapeutic strategies.
items.titleZh: 多胺在神经退行性蛋白病中的作用
items.summaryZh: 这篇综述系统比较了多胺在阿尔茨海默病、帕金森病、多聚谷氨酰胺病、ALS和多系统萎缩等神经退行性蛋白病中的作用。多胺代谢与蛋白质量控制、溶酶体、线粒体和氧化还原稳态紧密相连。亚精胺和精胺可影响神经毒性蛋白的组装、凝聚和清除，腐胺的作用则更依赖浓度和系统环境。多胺干预可能在不同疾病或阶段中表现出保护或有害的双重效应。作者提出一个框架，用于区分适应性改变与致病性失调，以指导治疗策略。
items.insight: 该综述将ALS置于更广泛的神经退行性蛋白病谱系中，强调多胺代谢作为连接蛋白稳态、线粒体功能和溶酶体清除的共同节点。对于ALS研究者，其价值在于提示多胺干预并非简单“有益”或“有害”，而是取决于多胺种类、浓度、细胞类型、疾病阶段和亚细胞定位。这一框架有助于解释既往多胺相关研究结果不一致的原因，并为靶向蛋白稳态和线粒体的联合治疗策略提供思路。

aiRead.keyFinding: 多胺代谢在ALS等神经退行性蛋白病中呈现疾病特异性改变，亚精胺和精胺可调节神经毒性蛋白的聚集与清除，但多胺干预的保护或有害效应取决于种类、浓度、细胞环境和疾病阶段。
aiRead.limitation: 作为综述，未提供新的原始实验数据；多胺在ALS中的具体因果机制和临床转化潜力仍需进一步研究验证。
aiRead.watchNext: 关注后续针对ALS中多胺代谢通路、亚精胺/精胺干预以及生物标志物动态变化的前瞻性研究和临床试验。

items.abstractZh: 多胺（PAs）是进化上保守的代谢物，将蛋白质质量控制与溶酶体、线粒体和氧化还原稳态联系起来。其代谢处于细胞维持与神经退行性通路的关键交汇点。在此，我们综合了阿尔茨海默病、帕金森病、多聚谷氨酰胺重复序列疾病、肌萎缩侧索硬化症和多系统萎缩的证据，这些疾病对多胺代谢变化的易感性各不相同。尽管以往的综述探讨了多胺在个别神经退行性疾病中的作用，但很少有研究在更广泛的神经退行性蛋白病谱系中比较其作用。在此，我们通过综合多种疾病的证据来填补这一空白，以探究多胺如何影响疾病相关蛋白的聚集和清除，以及这些效应如何取决于多胺种类、浓度、细胞环境、疾病阶段、亚细胞定位、氧化还原状态以及溶酶体和线粒体能力。人类组织和生物体液研究报告了与疾病相关的多胺代谢物、通路酶和转运体重塑的变化，这些变化因神经退行性疾病而异。机制研究表明，亚精胺和精胺可以改变各种神经毒性蛋白的组装、凝聚、区室化和清除，而腐胺的作用则更依赖于系统和浓度。这些效应涉及共享通路和不同机制，取决于蛋白质身份、细胞类型和亚细胞定位。奇怪的是，多胺操纵在一种情境下可能具有保护作用，而在另一种情境下则可能有害。我们提出的框架可以区分适应性重塑与致病性失调，并指导与疾病相关的治疗策略。
items.frontierRationale: 该综述新近整合了多胺在ALS等神经退行性蛋白病中的跨疾病证据，提出可区分适应性重塑与致病性失调的框架，对开发疾病相关治疗策略具有转化指导价值。

items.title: Potential Roles of Neuroimaging in Motor Neuron Disease.
items.summary: The review is intended to summarize and discuss the increasing roles and perspectives of neuroimaging in the clinical and scientific work-up of amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS) and other motor neuron diseases (MND). The applications of magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) and positron emission tomography (PET) identify characteristic disease-specific patterns especially for ALS including its clinical subtypes. Guided by neuroanatomical pattern stratification, these MND-associated alterations could be detected by dedicated analysis parameters from MRI, including T1-weighted structural imaging and microstructural diffusion tensor imaging, in combination with additional MR techniques, to act as diagnostic and monitoring biomarkers. Imaging in MND increasingly makes use of machine learning-based analysis methods. The conceptualization of (neuro-)imaging in ALS and other MND encompasses multiparametric technical approaches, also of regions outside the central nervous system, together with aspects of disease-specific pathophysiology which will further advance the field in future applications.
items.titleZh: 神经影像在运动神经元病中的潜在作用
items.summaryZh: 这篇综述系统梳理了MRI和PET在ALS及其他运动神经元病中的应用价值。核心观点是：通过T1加权结构成像、弥散张量成像等MRI技术，结合机器学习分析，可以识别ALS及其亚型的特征性影像模式，作为诊断和监测的生物标志物。未来方向包括多参数技术整合以及中枢神经系统以外区域的评估。
items.insight: 该综述为ALS影像学生物标志物的临床转化提供了整合性框架，特别强调了神经解剖模式分层和机器学习方法的应用。对于关注ALS诊断标志物和疾病监测的研究者而言，这篇综述有助于理解当前影像学技术的定位和未来发展方向，尤其是在多参数整合和CNS以外区域评估方面的前瞻性思考。

aiRead.keyFinding: MRI（T1加权结构成像、弥散张量成像）和PET可识别ALS及其他MND的特征性影像模式，结合机器学习分析可作为诊断和监测生物标志物，未来方向包括多参数技术整合和CNS以外区域评估。
aiRead.limitation: 作为综述，未提供原始数据或系统性荟萃分析；影像学生物标志物的标准化和临床验证仍不充分，各技术的敏感性和特异性有待进一步确认。
aiRead.watchNext: 关注多参数MRI/PET技术整合、机器学习分析方法在ALS影像学中的验证研究，以及中枢神经系统以外区域影像评估的后续临床转化进展。

items.abstractZh: 本综述旨在总结并讨论神经影像在肌萎缩侧索硬化（ALS）及其他运动神经元病（MND）的临床和科研评估中日益增加的作用与前景。磁共振成像（MRI）和正电子发射断层扫描（PET）的应用可识别出特征性的疾病特异性模式，尤其针对ALS及其临床亚型。在神经解剖模式分层的指导下，这些MND相关改变可通过MRI的专用分析参数检测，包括T1加权结构成像和微结构弥散张量成像，并结合其他MR技术，从而作为诊断和监测生物标志物。MND中的影像学越来越多地采用基于机器学习的分析方法。ALS及其他MND中（神经）影像学的概念化涵盖多参数技术方法，也包括中枢神经系统以外的区域，并结合疾病特异性病理生理学方面，这将在未来应用中进一步推动该领域发展。
items.frontierRationale: 该综述发表于2026年，系统整合了神经影像在ALS及其他运动神经元病中作为诊断和监测生物标志物的最新进展，并前瞻性地提出了多参数技术和机器学习驱动的发展方向，对推动ALS影像学生物标志物的临床转化具有参考价值。

items.title: Insights into X-linked Dystonia-Parkinsonism and Spinocerebellar Ataxia type 36 Through the Lens of Amyotrophic Lateral Sclerosis/Frontotemporal Dementia.
items.summary: The abnormal expansion of repetitive DNA sequences falls within the spectrum of neurological conditions driven by dual pathogenic pathways of RNA toxicity and protein toxicity. Within this spectrum, hexanucleotide repeat disorders (HRDs) represent a rare but important subgroup: C9orf72-amyotrophic lateral sclerosis/frontotemporal dementia (C9orf72-ALS/FTD), X-linked dystonia-parkinsonism (XDP) and spinocerebellar ataxia type 36 (SCA36), unified by the presence of expanded intronic repeats capable of forming non-canonical nucleic acid structures. Despite this shared repeat architecture, they differ in critical molecular and genetic respects: C9orf72-ALS/FTD is hallmarked by TDP-43 aggregation and prominent proteinopathy; SCA36 lacks TDP-43 pathology entirely; and XDP uniquely harbors a SINE-VNTR-Alu (SVA) retrotransposon insertion within the expanded locus and follows an X-linked recessive inheritance pattern. Among these, C9orf72-ALS/FTD is relatively well characterized, with established pathogenic mechanisms including G-quadruplex (G4) formation, dipeptide repeat (DPR) protein toxicity, RNA foci formation, and downstream cellular disruptions. The molecular mechanism underlying SCA36 and XDP remains comparatively less characterized. Given the mechanistic overlap with ALS/FTD, downstream disruptions such as RNA toxicity, mitochondrial dysfunction, impaired DNA repair and proteasomal dysfunction could similarly result from these core molecular processes. However, direct experimental evidence supporting these mechanisms in SCA36 and XDP remains limited. This review compares established, emerging and hypothetical mechanisms across HRDs to distinguish shared pathogenic pathways from disease-specific molecular features. Through horizontal comparison, this review identifies opportunities and limitations for translating ALS/FTD therapeutics to XDP and SCA36, establishing a unified analytical framework for mechanistic research and clinical intervention in rare repeat expansion disorders.
items.titleZh: 从肌萎缩侧索硬化/额颞叶痴呆的视角洞察X连锁肌张力障碍-帕金森综合征与脊髓小脑共济失调36型
items.summaryZh: 这是一篇综述，从ALS/FTD的机制视角横向比较三种六核苷酸重复扩增疾病：C9orf72-ALS/FTD、XDP和SCA36。三者共享扩增内含子重复序列可形成非经典核酸结构这一特征，但在TDP-43病理、遗传模式和基因组结构上存在差异。C9orf72-ALS/FTD机制研究较成熟，而XDP和SCA36的分子机制证据有限。作者提出RNA毒性、线粒体功能障碍、DNA修复受损和蛋白酶体功能障碍等下游紊乱可能在这些疾病中共享，并探讨将ALS/FTD治疗策略转化至XDP和SCA36的机遇与局限。
items.insight: 该综述为ALS研究者提供了一个横向比较框架，有助于识别C9orf72-ALS/FTD中已确立的机制（如G4形成、DPR毒性、RNA灶）在XDP和SCA36中是否保守。这对于判断ALS治疗策略（如ASO、靶向RNA毒性或线粒体保护）能否拓展至其他重复扩增疾病具有参考价值，同时提示需要更多直接实验证据来验证这些假设性机制。

aiRead.keyFinding: C9orf72-ALS/FTD、XDP和SCA36共享扩增内含子重复序列形成非经典核酸结构的特征，但TDP-43病理、遗传模式和基因组结构存在差异；ALS/FTD中已确立的机制可能部分适用于XDP和SCA36，但直接实验证据有限。
aiRead.limitation: XDP和SCA36的机制证据主要基于推断和假设，缺乏直接实验验证；综述未提供新的原始数据。
aiRead.watchNext: 关注后续在XDP和SCA36模型中验证RNA毒性、线粒体功能障碍、DNA修复和蛋白酶体功能等ALS/FTD相关机制的研究，以及将ALS/FTD治疗策略转化至这些疾病的临床前和临床尝试。

items.abstractZh: 重复DNA序列的异常扩增属于由RNA毒性和蛋白质毒性双重致病途径驱动的神经系统疾病谱。在该疾病谱中，六核苷酸重复扩增疾病（HRDs）代表一个罕见但重要的亚组：C9orf72-肌萎缩侧索硬化/额颞叶痴呆（C9orf72-ALS/FTD）、X连锁肌张力障碍-帕金森综合征（XDP）和脊髓小脑共济失调36型（SCA36），它们因存在能够形成非经典核酸结构的扩增内含子重复序列而统一。尽管具有这种共同的重复结构，它们在关键分子和遗传方面存在差异：C9orf72-ALS/FTD以TDP-43聚集和显著的蛋白质病变为标志；SCA36完全缺乏TDP-43病理；而XDP独特地在扩增位点内携带SINE-VNTR-Alu（SVA）逆转录转座子插入，并遵循X连锁隐性遗传模式。其中，C9orf72-ALS/FTD相对研究较为深入，已确立的致病机制包括G-四链体（G4）形成、二肽重复（DPR）蛋白毒性、RNA灶形成以及下游细胞功能紊乱。SCA36和XDP的分子机制研究相对较少。鉴于与ALS/FTD的机制重叠，RNA毒性、线粒体功能障碍、DNA修复受损和蛋白酶体功能障碍等下游紊乱可能同样由这些核心分子过程引起。然而，支持SCA36和XDP中这些机制的直接实验证据仍然有限。本综述比较了HRDs中已确立的、新兴的和假设性的机制，以区分共享的致病途径与疾病特异性分子特征。通过横向比较，本综述识别了将ALS/FTD治疗策略转化至XDP和SCA36的机遇与局限，为罕见重复扩增疾病的机制研究和临床干预建立了统一的分析框架。
items.frontierRationale: 该综述新近整合了ALS/FTD与XDP、SCA36等罕见重复扩增疾病的机制比较，为ALS治疗策略向其他重复扩增疾病的转化提供了分析框架。

items.title: Biomarker-Guided Diagnosis of Riboflavin Transporter Deficiency Presenting as Seronegative Myasthenia Gravis: A Short Report from a Consanguineous Family.
items.summary: Brown-Vialetto-Van Laere syndrome (BVVLS) is a rare, treatable neurodegenerative disorder caused by riboflavin transporter gene variants (SLC52A2, SLC52A3). Early symptoms can mimic neuromuscular junction disorders, causing diagnostic delays. A 3.5-year-old girl from consanguineous parents presented at 2.5 years with isolated bilateral ptosis, later developing dysphagia, dysphonia, facial diplegia, stridor, and respiratory compromise. Examination revealed tongue atrophy with fasciculations and bulbar weakness but normal limb strength. Diagnosed with seronegative myasthenia gravis, she failed to respond to corticosteroids, pyridostigmine, salbutamol, and intravenous immunoglobulin. Absence of fatigability, lower motor neuron signs, and a sibling history of hearing loss and bulbar palsy prompted genetic testing revealed a homozygous missense variant in SLC52A3 (c.670T > C; p.Phe224Leu). High-dose riboflavin (up to 50 mg/kg/day) led to gradual improvement in bulbar function, resolution of stridor, and respiratory stabilization, though ptosis and tongue fasciculations persisted. This report is novel in using clinical response to riboflavin as a functional biomarker for riboflavin transporter deficiency (RTD) in a patient with a variant of uncertain significance, unlike prior cases with definitive genetics. Empiric riboflavin challenge offers a practical framework when genetic results are ambiguous. RTD should be suspected in children with treatment-resistant, non-fluctuating ptosis and bulbar weakness, particularly with consanguinity or family history of hearing loss and bulbar palsy. Early high-dose riboflavin prevents decline, while immunosuppression is ineffective and potentially harmful.
items.evidenceLevel: 病例报告（单例，近亲婚配家庭）
items.titleZh: 以血清阴性重症肌无力为表现的核黄素转运体缺乏症的生物标志物引导诊断：来自一个近亲婚配家庭的简短报告
items.summaryZh: 该病例报告描述一名近亲婚配家庭的3.5岁女童，最初表现为血清阴性重症肌无力，对多种免疫治疗无效。因缺乏疲劳性、存在下运动神经元体征及家族史，经基因检测确诊为SLC52A3相关核黄素转运体缺乏症（BVVLS）。在携带意义未明变异的情况下，大剂量核黄素治疗带来延髓功能和呼吸状态改善，提示可将核黄素临床反应作为功能性生物标志物。报告强调，对治疗抵抗性、非波动性上睑下垂伴延髓无力的儿童应警惕RTD，早期大剂量核黄素可阻止病情进展，而免疫抑制治疗无效且可能有害。
items.insight: 该报告提示，在疑似神经肌肉接头疾病但治疗无效的儿童中，应把核黄素转运体缺乏症纳入鉴别诊断，并关注下运动神经元体征、家族史和近亲婚配背景。其提出的“核黄素激发试验作为功能性生物标志物”思路，对基因变异意义未明时的诊断决策具有参考价值，也提醒避免无效且可能有害的免疫抑制治疗。对ALS研究者而言，该病虽非ALS，但其延髓受累、呼吸功能恶化和可治疗性，为运动神经元病样表型的精准诊断与早期干预提供了可借鉴的临床路径。

aiRead.keyFinding: 在SLC52A3意义未明变异患者中，大剂量核黄素治疗改善延髓功能和呼吸状态，支持将核黄素临床反应作为功能性生物标志物。
aiRead.limitation: 仅单例病例，缺乏对照组和长期随访，无法确定核黄素反应与基因变异的因果性，也不能推广至所有RTD或ALS患者。

items.abstractZh: Brown-Vialetto-Van Laere综合征（BVVLS）是一种罕见的、可治疗的神经退行性疾病，由核黄素转运体基因变异（SLC52A2、SLC52A3）引起。其早期症状可模仿神经肌肉接头疾病，导致诊断延迟。一名来自近亲婚配家庭的3.5岁女童在2.5岁时表现为孤立性双侧上睑下垂，随后出现吞咽困难、发声困难、双侧面瘫、喘鸣和呼吸功能受损。检查发现舌萎缩伴肌束颤动及延髓肌无力，但肢体肌力正常。她被诊断为血清阴性重症肌无力，但对皮质类固醇、吡啶斯的明、沙丁胺醇和静脉注射免疫球蛋白均无反应。缺乏疲劳性、存在下运动神经元体征以及其同胞有听力丧失和延髓麻痹病史，促使进行基因检测，结果发现SLC52A3纯合错义变异（c.670T > C；p.Phe224Leu）。大剂量核黄素（最高达50 mg/kg/天）使延髓功能逐渐改善、喘鸣消失、呼吸稳定，但上睑下垂和舌肌束颤动持续存在。本报告的创新之处在于，对一名携带意义未明变异的患者，将核黄素临床反应用作核黄素转运体缺乏症（RTD）的功能性生物标志物，这不同于既往具有明确遗传学证据的病例。当基因结果不明确时，经验性核黄素激发试验提供了一个实用框架。对于表现为治疗抵抗性、非波动性上睑下垂和延髓肌无力的儿童，尤其是有近亲婚配或听力丧失和延髓麻痹家族史者，应怀疑RTD。早期大剂量核黄素可防止病情恶化，而免疫抑制治疗无效且可能有害。

items.title: Intrinsically disordered proteins and liquid-liquid phase separation: Molecular grammar, condensate physiology, and disease-relevant phase transitions.
items.summary: Intrinsically disordered proteins (IDPs) and intrinsically disordered regions (IDRs) of proteins constitute a substantial and functionally critical fraction of the eukaryotic proteome. Through multivalent, low-affinity interactions encoded in their low-complexity domains (LCDs), IDPs drive liquid-liquid phase separation (LLPS)-a physicochemical process that produces membraneless biomolecular condensates serving as dynamic reaction hubs within cells. Recent advances have substantially refined the conceptual framework governing condensate biophysics: the phase separation coupled to percolation (PSCP) model now recognizes that condensates are viscoelastic network fluids arising from the synergy between density transitions and connectivity (percolation) transitions, rather than simple LLPS alone. This updated mechanistic understanding, combined with proteome-wide computational tools and AI-driven prediction models, is rapidly transforming the field. Physiologically, condensates regulate transcription at super-enhancers, modulate RNA metabolism in stress granules, and orchestrate ribosome biogenesis in the nucleolus. Pathologically, aberrant liquid-to-solid transitions of disease-associated IDPs-including TDP-43 and FUS in amyotrophic lateral sclerosis and frontotemporal dementia, tau in Alzheimer's disease, and α-synuclein in Parkinson's disease-represent a convergent pathomechanism across neurodegenerative proteinopathies. Post-translational modifications, particularly phosphorylation, arginine methylation, and ubiquitination, function as a dynamic regulatory code controlling condensate assembly and dissolution. The emerging paradigm of condensate-modifying therapeutics (c-mods) identifies biomolecular condensates as druggable entities and proposes four mechanistic strategies-dissolvers, inducers, localizers, and morphers-to restore normal phase behavior in disease. This review integrates the most current molecular, cellular, and biomedical insights into IDP-driven phase separation, highlighting open questions and translational opportunities.

items.summaryZh: 该综述系统梳理了内在无序蛋白通过液-液相分离形成生物分子凝聚体的分子机制、生理功能及病理转变。重点指出TDP-43、FUS等ALS相关蛋白的异常液-固相变是神经退行性疾病的趋同病理机制，并介绍了以凝聚体为靶点的四类治疗策略（溶解剂、诱导剂、定位剂、形态调节剂）。

items.abstractZh: 内在无序蛋白（IDPs）和蛋白质的内在无序区域（IDRs）构成了真核蛋白质组中一个数量可观且功能关键的部分。通过其低复杂度结构域（LCDs）编码的多价、低亲和力相互作用，IDPs驱动液-液相分离（LLPS）——一种产生无膜生物分子凝聚体的物理化学过程，这些凝聚体在细胞内充当动态反应枢纽。近期进展显著完善了凝聚体生物物理学的概念框架：相分离耦合渗流（PSCP）模型现已认识到，凝聚体是由密度转变与连接性（渗流）转变协同作用产生的粘弹性网络流体，而非单纯的LLPS。这一更新的机制理解，结合全蛋白质组计算工具和AI驱动的预测模型，正在迅速改变该领域。在生理学上，凝聚体调控超级增强子处的转录、调节应激颗粒中的RNA代谢，并协调核仁中的核糖体生物发生。在病理学上，疾病相关IDPs的异常液-固转变——包括肌萎缩侧索硬化症和额颞叶痴呆中的TDP-43和FUS、阿尔茨海默病中的tau以及帕金森病中的α-突触核蛋白——代表了神经退行性蛋白质病中一种趋同的病理机制。翻译后修饰，特别是磷酸化、精氨酸甲基化和泛素化，作为控制凝聚体组装和解体的动态调控密码发挥作用。凝聚体修饰疗法（c-mods）这一新兴范式将生物分子凝聚体确定为可成药实体，并提出四种机制策略——溶解剂、诱导剂、定位剂和形态调节剂——以恢复疾病中的正常相行为。本综述整合了关于IDP驱动相分离的最新分子、细胞和生物医学见解，并强调了未解问题和转化机遇。
items.frontierRationale: 该综述整合了2026年最新的PSCP模型和AI预测工具，将TDP-43/FUS相变明确为ALS核心病理机制，并系统提出凝聚体修饰疗法策略，具有直接的ALS转化价值。

items.title: Identity-by-descent to resolve reduced penetrance and advance gene discovery in neurodegenerative disease.
items.summary: Advances in sequencing technologies have transformed human genetics and accelerated disease gene discovery. Yet a causal mutation remains to be identified for many families with an inherited disease. Incomplete penetrance, genetic heterogeneity, and limited family history can complicate the binary classification of familial and sporadic disease. These challenges are amplified in late-onset diseases such as amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS) and frontotemporal dementia (FTD), where obscured inheritance patterns limit gene discovery opportunities and can confound clinical risk assessment. We evaluated whether identity-by-descent (IBD) analysis can uncover cryptic relatedness and mitigate the impact of incomplete penetrance on disease gene mapping and clinical interpretation. Genome-wide IBD inference was performed in an integrated cross-continent cohort of 3,524 individuals of European ancestry spanning the ALS-FTD neurodegenerative spectrum. IBD identified 793 pairs of 1st-6th degree relatives (siblings to second cousins once removed), of which 31.5% were previously unrecognised and 15.8% had differing clinical diagnoses. Among individuals recorded as "sporadic", 5.5% of ALS and 15.9% of FTD were genetically related to another affected individual in the cohort, demonstrating that reduced penetrance masks a substantial proportion of heritable disease. Affected individuals with known ALS/FTD-associated genetic variants had balanced male-to-female ratios, irrespective of reported family history or IBD-inferred relatedness, whereas those without an identified disease-linked genetic variant retained the expected male predominance in ALS/FTD cohorts. IBD analysis identified multiple cross-continent founder networks for known ALS disease genes, including SOD1 and C9orf72, and created 73 new IBD-defined pedigrees from apparently unrelated probands, providing a framework for disease variant discovery in otherwise underpowered families. Using SOD1 mutation-positive families as a positive-control framework, we demonstrated that IBD-based pedigree expansion retained the known disease locus in distant relatives while reducing genome-wide candidate regions, supporting its application to unresolved ALS/FTD pedigrees. In an IBD-identified extended pedigree comprising five affected individuals, genome-wide variant filtering identified three rare variants within a chromosome 13q21.33 candidate locus shared IBD by four individuals and supported by multipoint linkage analysis. IBD-based detection of cryptic relatedness reveals genetic links between familial and apparent sporadic neurodegenerative disease, helping to resolve penetrance-related inheritance misclassification. By reconstructing extended pedigrees using IBD, this approach strengthens gene discovery and supporting variant pathogenicity while providing clinicians with clearer context for inherited risk and genetic counselling.
items.titleZh: 利用同源同一性解析神经退行性疾病中的不完全外显并推进基因发现
items.summaryZh: 该研究在3524名欧洲血统的ALS-FTD谱系个体中开展全基因组同源同一性（IBD）分析，发现大量被记录为“散发性”的患者实际上与其他患者存在遗传亲缘关系（ALS中5.5%，FTD中15.9%），提示不完全外显导致遗传模式被误判。IBD还识别出已知ALS基因（如SOD1、C9orf72）的跨大陆奠基者网络，并构建了73个新的IBD定义家系，为基因发现提供新框架。在一个扩展家系中，该方法帮助定位了染色体13q21.33候选位点。
items.insight: 这项研究为ALS遗传学中长期存在的“散发性”与“家族性”界限模糊问题提供了可操作的解决方案。通过IBD分析，研究者能够从看似无关的散发病例中重建隐藏的家系结构，从而恢复被不完全外显掩盖的遗传信号。这对于基因发现、变异致病性判定以及临床遗传咨询均具有直接转化意义，尤其适用于那些因家系规模小或外显率低而无法通过传统连锁分析获得足够效力的ALS家系。

aiRead.limitation: 研究主要基于欧洲血统个体，结论在其他人群中的普适性有待验证；IBD推断的亲缘关系依赖于队列样本量和基因分型密度，可能遗漏更远亲缘关系；未对识别出的新候选变异进行功能验证。
aiRead.watchNext: 后续应关注该团队是否将IBD框架应用于非欧洲人群，以及是否对染色体13q21.33候选位点进行功能验证；同时可期待基于IBD的家系重建被整合进ALS/FTD临床基因检测流程。

items.abstractZh: 测序技术的进步改变了人类遗传学并加速了疾病基因的发现。然而，对于许多患有遗传性疾病的家族而言，致病突变仍有待确定。不完全外显、遗传异质性以及有限的家族史可使家族性与散发性疾病的二元分类变得复杂。这些挑战在肌萎缩侧索硬化（ALS）和额颞叶痴呆（FTD）等晚发性疾病中被放大，因为被掩盖的遗传模式限制了基因发现的机会，并可能干扰临床风险评估。我们评估了同源同一性（IBD）分析能否揭示隐匿的亲缘关系，并减轻不完全外显对疾病基因定位和临床解读的影响。在一个涵盖ALS-FTD神经退行性疾病谱系、由3524名欧洲血统个体组成的跨大陆整合队列中进行了全基因组IBD推断。IBD识别出793对一至六级亲属（同胞至二级堂表亲的子女），其中31.5%此前未被识别，15.8%具有不同的临床诊断。在被记录为“散发性”的个体中，5.5%的ALS和15.9%的FTD患者与队列中另一名患病个体存在遗传亲缘关系，表明不完全外显掩盖了相当一部分遗传性疾病。携带已知ALS/FTD相关遗传变异的患病个体，无论报告的家族史或IBD推断的亲缘关系如何，男女比例均平衡；而未发现疾病相关遗传变异的个体则保留了ALS/FTD队列中预期的男性优势。IBD分析识别出已知ALS疾病基因（包括SOD1和C9orf72）的多个跨大陆奠基者网络，并从看似无关的先证者中创建了73个新的IBD定义家系，为在原本统计效力不足的家族中进行疾病变异发现提供了框架。以SOD1突变阳性家族作为阳性对照框架，我们证明基于IBD的家系扩展在远亲中保留了已知疾病位点，同时缩小了全基因组候选区域，支持其应用于未解决的ALS/FTD家系。在一个由五名患病个体组成的IBD识别扩展家系中，全基因组变异过滤在染色体13q21.33候选位点内识别出三个罕见变异，由四名个体共享IBD，并得到多点连锁分析的支持。基于IBD的隐匿亲缘关系检测揭示了家族性与表观散发性神经退行性疾病之间的遗传联系，有助于解决与外显率相关的遗传模式误分类。通过利用IBD重建扩展家系，该方法加强了基因发现并支持变异致病性判定，同时为临床医生提供了关于遗传风险和遗传咨询的更清晰背景。
items.frontierRationale: 该研究利用大规模跨大陆队列的IBD分析，新近揭示了ALS/FTD中隐匿亲缘关系对不完全外显的解析价值，并展示了其在基因发现和临床解读中的转化潜力。
